package.description: TA interview voice agent automation generated from exported documentation.

workflows.name: Main
workflows.description: Primary TA interview orchestration entry point.

steps.notes: Seed entry workflow so local build has an explicit main workflow.

processNodes.name: Poll New Job Requisitions
processNodes.description: Time-based trigger polls Ashby every 15 minutes for new job requisitions.

processNodes.name: Retrieve Job Description and Hiring Notes
processNodes.description: Call Ashby API to retrieve job details, hiring notes, and recruiter context.

processNodes.name: Create Job Requisition Queue Item
processNodes.description: Create queue item in JobRequisitionQueue with job ID, title, description, and Slack IDs.

processNodes.name: Generate Core Interview Questions
processNodes.description: Use OpenAI to generate role-specific interview questions and probing follow-ups.

processNodes.name: Store Generated Question Set
processNodes.description: Store generated question set in InterviewQuestions storage bucket keyed by Job ID.

processNodes.name: Create Hiring Manager Approval Task
processNodes.description: Create Action Center task in QuestionApprovalCatalog for hiring manager approval.

processNodes.name: Notify Hiring Manager in Slack
processNodes.description: Send hiring manager Slack DM with preview and Action Center task link.

processNodes.name: Approval Outcome Received
processNodes.description: Wait for Action Center completion and branch based on approved, edited, or rework outcome.

processNodes.name: Persist Approved or Edited Questions
processNodes.description: Retrieve approved or edited questions and overwrite InterviewQuestions bucket as needed.

processNodes.name: Create Interview Link in Ashby
processNodes.description: Create candidate interview event in Ashby and retrieve interview link.

processNodes.name: Queue Interview Session
processNodes.description: Create InterviewSessionQueue item with candidate metadata, job metadata, and approved questions.

processNodes.name: Initialize Voice Agent Session
processNodes.description: Create voice session via Vapi.ai or equivalent with anti-manipulation prompt and approved questions.

processNodes.name: Candidate Joins Session
processNodes.description: Track whether candidate joins, continues, no-shows, or exits early.

processNodes.name: Capture Transcript and Completion Metadata
processNodes.description: Store transcript, completion status, exit reason, and session duration for completed or partial sessions.

processNodes.name: Create Report Generation Queue Item
processNodes.description: Create ReportGenerationQueue item with transcript and metadata.

processNodes.name: Generate Interview Report
processNodes.description: Use OpenAI to generate structured interview report, recommendation, and observations.

processNodes.name: Store Interview Report
processNodes.description: Store completed or partial report in InterviewReports storage bucket.

processNodes.name: Create Slack Delivery Queue Item
processNodes.description: Create SlackDeliveryQueue item with report content and recipient Slack IDs.

processNodes.name: Send Slack DMs
processNodes.description: Send report to hiring manager and next interviewer via Slack DM.

processNodes.name: Hiring Manager Decides Next Step
processNodes.description: Hiring manager reviews Slack-delivered report and decides whether candidate advances or is rejected.

processNodes.name: Update Candidate Disposition
processNodes.description: Update candidate disposition in Ashby based on advance or reject decision.

processNodes.name: Advance Candidate End
processNodes.description: Candidate advances to the next stage.

processNodes.name: Reject Candidate End
processNodes.description: Candidate rejected after interview review.

queues.name: JobRequisitionQueue
queues.description: Holds new job requisitions for question generation.

queues.name: InterviewSessionQueue
queues.description: Holds approved interview sessions with candidate and job metadata for voice agent initiation.

queues.name: ReportGenerationQueue
queues.description: Holds completed interview transcripts and metadata for AI report generation.

queues.name: SlackDeliveryQueue
queues.description: Holds generated interview reports and recipient Slack IDs for DM delivery.

assets.name: OpenAIAPIKey
assets.description: API credential for OpenAI question and report generation.

assets.name: SlackBotToken
assets.description: Bot token for Slack DM delivery.

assets.name: VapiAPIKey
assets.description: API credential for voice agent platform integration.

assets.name: DefaultQuestionTemplate
assets.description: Fallback question template used if AI generation fails.

storageBuckets.name: InterviewQuestions
storageBuckets.description: Stores generated and approved question sets keyed by Job ID.

storageBuckets.name: InterviewSchedule
storageBuckets.description: Stores created interview links keyed by Job ID and Candidate ID.

storageBuckets.name: InterviewReports
storageBuckets.description: Stores completed and partial interview reports.

triggers.name: JobRequisitionPollingEvery15Min
triggers.description: Polls Ashby every 15 minutes for new requisitions.

triggers.name: InterviewSessionQueueTrigger
triggers.description: Starts interview session workflow when approved interview items are queued.

triggers.name: ReportGenerationQueueTrigger
triggers.description: Starts report generation workflow when transcripts are queued.

triggers.name: SlackDeliveryQueueTrigger
triggers.description: Starts Slack delivery workflow when reports are queued.

agents.description: TAInterviewVoiceAgent for anti-manipulation first-round interview execution.
guardrails: Probe vague answers up to two times
Flag no-show, early exit, and time-limit outcomes explicitly
